about: Genesys International Corporation Ltd provides end-to-end geospatial data capture, processing, analytics, platforms and APIs. Its proprietary content spans pan-India 2D navigation/HD maps, street imagery and 3D digital twins for urban governance, infrastructure, utilities, mobility and location intelligence in India and overseas.
